name: Andromeda II (Hubble)
blurb: Andromeda II, a dwarf spheroidal galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: andromedaii-hubble
story: A faint dwarf spheroidal companion of the Andromeda Galaxy. Hubble looked deep enough to sort its individual stars and read its long history of star formation, among the most drawn-out of the six Andromeda dwarfs the ISLAndS project studied.

claims.text: Andromeda II is a dwarf spheroidal satellite of the Andromeda Galaxy (M31)
Hubble program 13028 targeted Andromeda II for deep color-magnitude diagrams
The ISLAndS project studied six Andromeda dSphs with Hubble
Andromeda II has one of the most extended star formation histories in the sample
